fascinating comments on possible
slowdown –  but probably a red herring.

- Anthropic and OpenAI presumably aren’t colluding to slowdown, they are asking governments to build a framework such that a slowdown might be mandatory at some point.
- governments are free(ish) to regulate companies in many ways; no obvious reason they couldn’t do what was asked
- separately antitrust was built for things like price fixing, not this per se, and government has fairly broad latitude about what to prosecute
